basic_details.job_title: WCD Balodabazar Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 4 Psycho-social Counsellor & Case Worker Posts
basic_details.short_information: Women and Child Development Balodabazar-Bhatapara (WCD Balodabazar) is conducting a walk-in interview to fill 4 vacancies for Psycho-social Counsellor (1 vacancy) and Case Worker (2 vacancies) posts on a contract basis. Female candidates who are native residents of Chhattisgarh can attend the walk-in interview on 14 October 2026 reporting at 10:00 AM at the Office of the District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development Department. The notified consolidated pay is Rs. 25,780 for Psycho-social Counsellor and Rs. 18,420 for Case Worker. Applicants must bring the application in the prescrib

age_limit.details: Candidates must be between 21 years and 35 years of age as of 01-01-2026. The maximum upper age limit including all relaxations issued by the General Administration Department of Chhattisgarh shall not exceed 45 years.

post_wise_qualification.post_name: Psycho-social Counsellor (Sakhi One Stop Centre Balodabazar & Simga)
post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Any woman having professional degree/diploma in psychology/psychiatry/neuroscience with a background in health sector and preferably with at least 3 years experience of working within a Government or Non-Government health project/programme at the district level.

post_wise_qualification.post_name: Case Worker (Sakhi One Stop Centre Balodabazar)
post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Any woman having a Bachelor in Law/Social Work/Sociology/Social Science/Psychology with at least 3 years experience of working on women related relevant domains in a Government or Non-Government Project/Programme. Must be a resident of the local community.

qualification.details: Candidates must be between 21 years and 35 years of age as of 01-01-2026. The maximum upper age limit including all relaxations issued by the General Administration Department of Chhattisgarh shall not exceed 45 years.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 21 years and 35 years of age as of 01-01-2026. The maximum upper age limit including all relaxations issued by the General Administration Department of Chhattisgarh shall not exceed 45 years.

rows.post_name: Psycho-social Counsellor (Sakhi One Stop Centre Balodabazar & Simga)
rows.qualification_required: Any woman having professional degree/diploma in psychology/psychiatry/neuroscience with a background in health sector and preferably with at least 3 years experience of working within a Government or Non-Government health project/programme at the district level.

rows.post_name: Case Worker (Sakhi One Stop Centre Balodabazar)
rows.qualification_required: Any woman having a Bachelor in Law/Social Work/Sociology/Social Science/Psychology with at least 3 years experience of working on women related relevant domains in a Government or Non-Government Project/Programme. Must be a resident of the local community.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Application form in the prescribed format filled properly with a passport-size photograph affixed and signed across. Self-attested copies of 10th marksheet / birth certificate for age verification. Self-attested copies of 12th marksheet, Graduation marksheet, Post Graduation marksheet (if applicable), and professional degrees or diplomas. Caste certificate and permanent residential certificate of Chhattisgarh issued by a competent authority. Employment registration card copy. Complete and verified work experience certificates issued by the employer through a competent authority. Identity proof such as Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, etc. One self-addressed envelope affixed with a Rs. 10 postal stamp. Original documents along with self-attested copies for verification during the process.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Registration and collection of applications take place from 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM. Preliminary claim and objection list publication at 01:00 PM. Receiving claims and objections from 01:15 PM to 01:45 PM. Disposal of received claims and objections from 02:00 PM to 02:30 PM. Publication of the final eligibility list at 03:00 PM. Skill test for a maximum of 10 participants in order of merit from 03:30 PM to 04:30 PM. Interview from 04:30 PM to 05:30 PM.

rows.details: Download official notification and application format

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: Appointments are made on a consolidated service fee for an initial period of 2 years, which may be extended annually based on performance, conduct, and departmental requirements.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any HRA or additional allowances paid on top of the consolidated pay?
faq.answer: No other salary, allowance, or grant is payable beyond the fixed consolidated service fee, except for eligible traveling allowances when sent out on official tour or training.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Relaxation in age limit is applicable as per the instructions issued by the General Administration Department of Chhattisgarh, subject to an absolute maximum upper age limit of 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents are required to prove work experience?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit full-time work experience certificates issued and verified by the employer or competent authority of the respective institution. Voluntary service certificates are not considered valid experience.
